title: Strong Nakayama Conjecture
exact_target: Does every Artin algebra $A$ have finite finitistic dimension? For every nonzero finitely generated $A$-module $M$, must there be an integer $n\geq0$ such that $\operatorname{Ext}_A^n(M,A)\neq0$?
